content.title: Academic Writing Test 2
content.source: IELTS.org, Academic Writing sample tasks 2023 (Task 1B and Task 2B)
content.description: Task 1 describes a line graph of radio and television audiences. Task 2 weighs the costs and benefits of international tourism.

tasks.promptHtml:
The graph below shows radio and television audiences throughout the day in 1992.

Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

Write about the following topic:

International tourism has brought enormous benefit to many places. At the same time, there is concern about its impact on local inhabitants and the environment.

Do the disadvantages of international tourism outweigh the advantages?

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.
